result.summary: The page is mostly intact, with one clear visual defect: the hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' failed to load and shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon. The carousel and bottom-of-viewport clipping are expected scroll behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section has no cover photo. It shows a flat grey box with a broken-image icon, while other cards (e.g. the pizza card below it) render their imagery correctly.
issues.suggestion: Check the image URL or asset for this restaurant and fix the load failure. Add a branded fallback (e.g. a cuisine illustration or restaurant logo) so a failed load does not expose a broken-image icon.
